{{Top|canon=vocoder mask}}
[[File:Anomidgg12.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Anomids wearing vocalizer masks]]
A '''vocalizer mask''' or '''electronic mask''' was a translation device worn over one's face by species incapable of speaking [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic]] or other languages widely spoken in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Vocalizer masks were commonly used by [[Anomid/Legends|Anomids]] due to their lack of vocal cords. They converted subtle movements of the wearer's jaw and throat muscles into audible Basic.

Similarly, [[electronic mask]]s worn by the [[Qieg/Legends|Qieg]] approximated the [[Human/Legends|Human]] voice box and reproduced the vocal ranges, allowing them to communicate with Humans as their own [[Qieg language|language]] was a series of chirps and clicks, augmented by body language.<ref name="Lan Barell article">{{JournalCite|1|Lan Barell (article)}}</ref>
